text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT — high RPM on model family 'orion-13b'. 5.1% error rate, p95 latency up 3x, sustained for 6m. Affected region: us-west-2. Paging on-call. <https://grafana.company/graphs/orion-13b|graphs>
ryan: on it. ryan taking pager. any idea cause? high traffic from a small set of customers or systemic? :eyes:
maya: looking at traffic by api_key. top 5 keys account for ~68% of recent RPM. one key (cust-47) is very chatty, long contexts.
leo: perf note — ORION-13B has heavy KV-cache churn with long sequences, we hit GPU mem spill and some retry loops. my suggestion: temporary per-model RPM cap + disable streaming for high-cost tokens.
ryan: ok plan: 1) carve out top offending api keys with stricter per-key RPM, 2) reduce global per-model RPM to buy breathing room, 3) disable streaming/funcall on orion-13b for hosted tier. Agree?
claire: +1. Support: flag customers for mitigation emails and set internal status. I'll start drafting a note for those likely impacted.
ryan: executing step 2 first to reduce blast radius. running internal command now:

```
# reduce global RPM/TMP for orion-13b
redwoodctl quota update --model orion-13b --rpm=900 --tpm=18000 --reason="emergency surge 1785001234"
```

ryan: command returned: OK — orion-13b rpm=900 tpm=18000 (propagating)
incident-bot: CONFIG CHANGE DETECTED — quota.update by ryan at 1785001287. Propagation to edge clusters in progress.
maya: while that rolls, I'll carve out the top keys. command to set per-key override:

```
redwoodctl quota override --api-key=cust-47 --model=orion-13b --rpm=120 --tpm=2400 --reason="protect cluster"
```

maya: override applied for cust-47 and cust-88. sending DM to customers via support.
support-team: noted, emailing cust-47 and cust-88 now with ETA and mitigation steps. tagging CLAIRE for approvals.
claire: sent. included workaround: lower client-side concurrency and shorter context. asked if they can shift non-urgent batch jobs to off-peak.
leo: quick telemetry update: after rpm cap at 900 we see RPM drop ~45% and error rate down to 1.2% within 90s. p95 latency improving. still seeing occasional GPU OOMs in one cluster.
ryan: disabling streaming on orion-13b for hosted to avoid long-lived connections:

```
feature-flag set orion-13b.disable_streaming=true --until=2h --reason="surge mitigation"
```

ryan: flag applied. will monitor.
incident-bot: METRIC UPDATE — errors 0.8% (down), RPM stable at target ~920, p95 latency trending down. (1785001398)
maya: leaving a small headroom — recommend keeping rpm=900 and per-key overrides for 30m, then evaluate rollback.
leo: operational follow-up: I'll spin a one-off extra pod pool for orion-13b on standby in case backlog resumes. ETA 12m.
ryan: agreed. creating an incident follow-up ticket for postmortem and capacity plan. if numbers stay steady we'll downgrade to P2 and close the page in 1h.
support-team: monitoring customer replies. cust-47 acknowledged and throttled their client — they saw immediate improvement.
ryan: thanks everyone. continuing to watch. reopen thread if we get new spikes. :thumbsup:
